FIELDS.DESCRIPTION OF OPERATIONS: At Asphalt Solutions Co., we specialize in providing high-quality asphalt and paving services for residential, commercial, and municipal clients. Our core operations include the installation and repair of asphalt driveways, parking lots, and roads, utilizing modern equipment and techniques to ensure durability and aesthetics. Our experienced team is committed to safety and efficiency, following a comprehensive safety program and providing regular training on equipment use. We maintain strong relationships with dependable suppliers for materials, ensuring consistent quality and timely project completion. With a focus on customer satisfaction, we prioritize clear communication and effective project management, delivering results that meet our clients' needs while adhering to environmental regulations and industry standards.
FIELDS.DESCRIPTION OF LOSSES: On March 2, 2022, we experienced a loss due to a delivery truck accidentally driving over fresh asphalt, causing damage that required repair. The estimated cost of this loss was $5,000.00. The claim has been resolved, and payment was received in full by our insurance provider.
FIELDS.SAFE/VAULT DETAILS: Class 3, Grade B, Secure Storage Vault
FIELDS.OTHER PROTECTION: Security fencing and on-site watchpersons during operational hours to enhance safety and deter unauthorized access.
